knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)

USGS distributes Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2 products with surface reflectance (SR) and surface temperature (ST) already computed. In this vignette we run METRIC directly from those products: no raw digital numbers (DN) are needed, surface reflectance is read with `loadImageSR()` and surface temperature is taken from the `ST_B10` band (loaded by `loadImageSR()` as `Band_10`) through the `surf.temp` argument of `METRIC.EB()`.

## Simple procedure

As Landsat scenes are almost 1Gb in size, we do not recommend using one complete scene without cropping an area-of-interest first. An area-of-interest can be defined using `createAoi()` function:

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(water)
aoi <- createAoi(topleft = c(500000, -3644000), bottomright = c(526000, -3660000))
```

The Level-2 scene is not included in **water**; download it first (e.g., from [Earth Explorer](https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/)) and set `scene_folder` to its location. The Level-2 scene folder contains the SR bands (`*_SR_B2.TIF` to `*_SR_B7.TIF`), the ST band (`*_ST_B10.TIF`) and the metadata file (`*_MTL.txt`). `loadImageSR()` reads the SR bands, names them by band number and rescales them to reflectance (DN * 0.0000275 - 0.2). For Landsat 8 it also adds the surface temperature as the last layer, `Band_10`, rescaled to Kelvin (DN * 0.00341802 + 149):

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 7}
scene_folder <- "../../L8/LC08_L2SP_232083_20160209_20200907_02_T1"
image.SR <- loadImageSR(path = scene_folder, aoi = aoi)
plot(image.SR)
```

Finally, the simple procedure for estimating METRIC can be applied using only SR and ST. As `surf.temp` is supplied, `METRIC.EB()` uses it as surface temperature instead of estimating it from the thermal bands:

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 7}
csvfile <- system.file("extdata", "INTA.csv", package="water")
MTLfile <- file.path(scene_folder, "LC08_L2SP_232083_20160209_20200907_02_T1_MTL.txt")
WeatherStation <- read.WSdata(WSdata = csvfile,
                              datetime.format =  "%Y/%m/%d %H:%M",
                              columns=c("date" = 1, "time" = 1, "radiation" = 5,
                              "wind" = 6, "RH" = 3, "temp" = 2, "rain" = 4),
                              lat=-33.00513, long= -68.86469, elev=927, height= 2,
                              MTL=MTLfile)
Energy.Balance <- METRIC.EB(image.SR = image.SR, surf.temp = image.SR$Band_10,
                            plain=TRUE, aoi=aoi, n = 5, WeatherStation = WeatherStation,
                            ETp.coef = 1.2, sat="L8", alb.coeff = "Olmedo",
                            LAI.method = "metric2010", Z.om.ws = 0.03, MTL = MTLfile)
plot(Energy.Balance$EB)
```
